sections.title: From core to themes
body: Field mapping and types live in @rokkit/core. Reactive wrappers live in @rokkit/states. Keyboard navigation and interactions in @rokkit/actions. Filtering and transforms in @rokkit/data. Components in @rokkit/ui, with forms and charts on top, and themes and icons as plain CSS and assets.

sections.title: Dependencies only point down
body: No package imports from one above it. The UI never imports forms; state never imports UI. That keeps each layer testable on its own and stops accidental cycles.

sections.title: Composition over configuration
body: Components do one job. A list does not grow searchable, filterable and sortable flags; you compose a search with a list instead.

sections.title: Architecture as a guardrail
body: A strict dependency order is a rule an assistant can follow and a reviewer can check. It is one of the simplest ways to stop generated code from creeping across boundaries.
